name: fruit-burst-reveal
title: Fruit Burst Reveal
description: A product reveal in one drawn scene: a line draws a circle and splashes droplets, a coloured fill sweeps diagonally across it, the core, stalk and leaf pop in with elastic overshoots, the whole piece wobbles, swells and bursts into particles before a caption rises.
useWhen: A fresh product (drink, fruit, snack) needs a playful splash-and-pop reveal with a caption.
A launch beat where a drawn object builds, wobbles and bursts.
avoidWhen: The product must be a real photo or an exact logo.
A calm premium tone is wanted: the burst is lively.
author: chrisgannon

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Text that rises after the burst. Leave empty for none.

variables.label: Fruit color
variables.description: Colour of the fill and half of the droplets.

variables.label: Line color
variables.description: Outline, stalk and the other droplets.
